E2_small_support_caveat: For2/3modalities, top3/top10 with k=min(k,M) includes all modalities and yields trivial Jaccard. Report as non-discriminating; do not claim stability from that alone. Signed magnitude/order/distribution comparisons remain necessary.
TV_policy: Only comparable normalized nonnegative attribution magnitude distributions over identical feature support; all-zero distribution reported degenerate, not silently passing
no_new_randomness: Analytical E2 deterministic; seeds used only for predeclared stochastic stages, not arbitrary reference reselection
rank_policy: Fixed feature identity alignment, deterministic lexical tie-breaking; k=min(k,feature_count)
stochasticity: Only documented governed sources; deterministic methods repeated, do not invent random perturbations
